scripts.lint: oxlint src e2e next.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs -c ./.oxlintrc.json
scripts.format: oxfmt src e2e docs AGENTS.md README.md DESIGN.md --write --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.format:check: oxfmt src e2e docs AGENTS.md README.md DESIGN.md --check --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.docs:check: pnpm pro-gov doctor && pnpm doc-gov router-check && pnpm doc-gov check && pnpm doc-gov scan --check && pnpm doc-gov links && pnpm doc-gov audit && pnpm doc-gov doctor
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm test
